calls.title: Starttech Ventures + GrowthBook
calls.summary: Christian Liebenow (GrowthBook sales) demoed GrowthBook to Aristeidis Kypriotis (Startech Ventures, a venture builder supporting 3-4 portfolio companies). Aristeidis needs an affordable replacement for Google Optimize with Bayesian statistics, visual editor, Google Analytics integration, and multi-tenant separation. Next steps: Christian will email documentation on Google Analytics integration and organization-based separation (since Pro lacks projects), with a follow-up call after his Hawaii trip.
